verdict_reason: Not player content. Its own description says to remove it once the stall is attributed, and the closing item COLD_LOAD_STALL_INTERMITTENT_1 (closed) concluded there was no stall (get_ui_state returned in 0.0 s; the menu reached Playing in 56 s) and says LoadTracer "is a diagnostic; remove it from the mod list before the owner's real play sessions". It earns its place today only as an instrument (it produced the per-mod static_ctors figures used here). Exit: drop it from FULL.LATEST before real play; keep the source under src/ as an instrument. It overrides a vanilla startup method, so it should not ship to players (brief S1 audience tension noted).
